{
  "scripts": {
    "lint:eslint": "eslint --ext .js,.ts . --ignore-path .gitignore",
    "format:eslint": "eslint --ext .js,.ts . --fix --ignore-path .gitignore",
    "lint:prettier": "prettier \"**/*.{js,ts}\" --check --ignore-path .gitignore",
    "format:prettier": "prettier \"**/*.{js,ts}\" --write --ignore-path .gitignore",
    "lint": "npm run lint:eslint && npm run lint:prettier",
    "format": "npm run format:eslint && npm run format:prettier",
    "test": "vitest run --coverage",
    "test:watch": "vitest",
    "build": "rimraf dist && rollup -c rollup.config.js",
    "start:build": "npm run build && web-dev-server --root-dir dist --app-index index.html --open --compatibility none",
    "start": "web-dev-server --app-index index.html --host 0.0.0.0 --node-resolve --open --watch --port 8001",
    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@maplibre/maplibre-gl-style-spec": "^26.5.1",
    "@rollup/plugin-node-resolve": "^16.0.3",
    "@rollup/plugin-replace": "^5.0.7",
    "@rollup/plugin-terser": "^1.0.2",
    "@rollup/plugin-typescript": "^12.3.1",
    "@typescript-eslint/parser": "^8.72.1",
    "@vitest/coverage-v8": "^5.1.0",
    "@web/dev-server": "^0.4.6",
    "@web/dev-server-esbuild": "^1.0.5",
    "@web/dev-server-rollup": "^0.6.4",
    "@web/rollup-plugin-html": "^3.1.0",
    "@web/rollup-plugin-polyfills-loader": "^2.1.3",
    "eslint": "^8.57.1",
    "eslint-config-prettier": "^7.2.0",
    "eslint-config-standard": "^17.1.0",
    "eslint-plugin-import": "^2.31.0",
    "eslint-plugin-lit": "^2.2.1",
    "eslint-plugin-lit-a11y": "^4.1.4",
    "eslint-plugin-n": "^16.6.2",
    "eslint-plugin-no-only-tests": "^3.3.0",
    "eslint-plugin-promise": "^6.6.0",
    "eslint-plugin-wc": "^3.1.0",
    "happy-dom": "^21.0.4",
    "husky": "^4.3.8",
    "lint-staged": "^10.5.4",
    "prettier": "^2.8.8",
    "rimraf": "^3.0.2",
    "rollup": "^4.67.5",
    "rollup-plugin-copy": "^3.5.0",
    "rollup-plugin-version-injector": "^1.3.3",
    "rollup-plugin-workbox": "^8.1.3",
    "typescript": "^5.9.3",
    "vitest": "^5.1.0"
  },
  "browser": {
    "crypto": false
  },
  "eslintConfig": {
    "extends": [
      "standard",
      "plugin:lit/recommended",
      "plugin:wc/recommended",
      "plugin:lit-a11y/recommended",
      "prettier"
    ],
    "plugins": [
      "no-only-tests"
    ],
    "rules": {
      "no-only-tests/no-only-tests": "error"
    },
    "env": {
      "browser": true
    },
    "overrides": [
      {
        "files": [
          "test/**/*.js"
        ],
        "rules": {
          "import/no-extraneous-dependencies": [
            "error",
            {
              "devDependencies": true
            }
          ],
          "no-unused-expressions": "off"
        }
      },
      {
        "files": [
          "vitest.config.js"
        ],
        "rules": {
          "import/no-unresolved": "off"
        }
      },
      {
        "files": [
          "**/*.ts"
        ],
        "parser": "@typescript-eslint/parser",
        "rules": {
          "no-undef": "off"
        }
      }
    ]
  },
  "prettier": {
    "singleQuote": true,
    "arrowParens": "avoid",
    "semi": false,
    "bracketSpacing": false
  },
  "husky": {
    "hooks": {
      "pre-commit": "lint-staged"
    }
  },
  "lint-staged": {
    "*.{js,ts}": [
      "eslint --fix",
      "prettier --write"
    ]
  },
  "name": "gramps-js",
  "version": "26.11.2",
  "description": "The frontend for the Gramps Web genealogical research system.",
  "author": "David M. Straub",
  "license": "AGPL-3.0-or-later",
  "type": "module",
  "dependencies": {
    "@americana/diplomat": "^0.6.0",
    "@awesome.me/webawesome": "^3.14.0",
    "@hpcc-js/wasm": "^2.36.0",
    "@material/material-color-utilities": "^0.4.0",
    "@material/mwc-drawer": "^0.27.0",
    "@material/mwc-top-app-bar": "^0.27.0",
    "@material/web": "^2.5.0",
    "@mdi/js": "^7.4.47",
    "@tmcw/togeojson": "7.1.3",
    "d3": "^7.9.2",
    "d3-array": "^3.2.5",
    "d3-axis": "^3.0.1",
    "d3-color": "^3.1.1",
    "d3-hierarchy": "^3.1.3",
    "d3-interpolate": "^3.0.2",
    "d3-scale": "^4.0.3",
    "d3-scale-chromatic": "^3.1.1",
    "d3-selection": "^3.0.1",
    "d3-shape": "^3.2.1",
    "d3-zoom": "^3.0.1",
    "dayjs": "^1.11.23",
    "dompurify": "^3.4.17",
    "jsondiffpatch": "^0.7.7",
    "jwt-decode": "^4.0.0",
    "lit": "^3.2.1",
    "maplibre-gl": "^6.16.0",
    "marked": "^18.1.3",
    "pwa-helper-components": "^0.2.10",
    "pwa-helpers": "^0.9.1",
    "tippy.js": "^6.3.7"
  }
}
